display.server: Xvfb 1920x1080x24, no window manager, no compositor

library.icons: every made-up game has one (Steam 32 px, app menu 48 px, Heroic 64 px, Lutris 128 px)

petals.frame_rate_source: FRAME in hanami/src/main.rs of the measured commit

cpu.unit: percent of one logical core; one fully used logical core is 100
cpu.how: Hanami's own user + system time from /proc/<pid>/stat over the sample; the X server's work is not counted

panel_states.hidden_at_start: hidden, 3 s after start, the library loaded
panel_states.open: open and idle, 1 s after the first open drew, no input, list at the top
panel_states.hidden_after_opens: hidden again after every open and hide, 1 s after the last, icons kept

memory.rss: resident: everything in memory, shared libraries counted in full
memory.pss: proportional: shared pages split between the programs using them

timings.scan: external: the whole `hanami --list` process; per source: internal, Hanami's log
timings.cold.to_first_pixel: external: starting `hanami` until the panel's middle has a drawn pixel
timings.warm.to_first_pixel: external: starting `hanami --toggle` until the hidden panel has a drawn pixel
timings.warm.hotkey_to_first_pixel: external: Ctrl+Alt+H sent through XTest until the panel has a drawn pixel in the X server
timings.warm.finding_games_per_open: internal: Hanami's log; it runs after the panel is up
